items.title: Boot screen is mostly empty black with a hairline progress bar
items.what: Loading screen (first image): the diamond-$ logo, three short gold text lines and a 2 px gold rule sit dead-center in a 390×844 black frame; roughly 80 % of the pixels are unused void.
items.why: First five seconds give almost no proof the game is downloading or how long it will take; the layout reads as a placeholder and raises bounce on launch.
items.how: Scale the logo 1.5×, thicken the bar to 8 px with a live percent, and add a looping, very low-opacity light-ray or particle in the empty vertical bands while keeping the tungsten-black grade.

items.title: Fighters sit small with a band of empty tatami below them
items.what: In-fight portrait frames (82aNm, z2m30, 6T3bq, iYk5L): the two sprites occupy the middle-lower third of the 3D view; a wide unused strip of tatami lies between their feet and the analog HUD, while glowing windows dominate the top half.
items.why: On a phone the karateka become postage-stamp sized, hits lack weight, and the player’s eyes must travel from the sticks up to distant characters every exchange.
items.how: Dolly/crop the camera so heads reach the upper third and feet sit just above the HUD, filling ~60 % of the 3D viewport; preserve the existing night-dojo lighting.

items.title: Analog sticks clustered bottom-center instead of lower corners
items.what: Portrait fight HUDs (g4SRy, 82aNm, AJ6Gu, z2m30) park both large rings side-by-side in the bottom-center; the landscape capture (Sk92j) already places them in the far lower-left and lower-right corners.
items.why: Thumbs are forced inward, covering more of the action and causing accidental dual-stick hits; corner placement is the mobile twin-stick standard.
items.how: Inset stance stick 16 px from left+bottom and technique stick 16 px from right+bottom in portrait, matching the landscape treatment already shipping.

items.title: Moves overlay is a dense low-contrast wall of 12 px type
items.what: TECHNIQUES panel (5EsFj): ten rows of small gold-on-dark text, tiny stick-glyph icons and right-aligned “mid · Half point” labels that require squinting on a 390 px screen.
items.why: The only in-game way to learn the ten combinations is this list; if unreadable, players never leave the two default punches and the game feels shallow.
items.how: Raise body to 17 px, enlarge stick diagrams to 32 px, use white for move names and a brighter gold for point values, and add a simple color pip for full vs half-point.

items.title: Settings uses blank gray squares instead of recognizable controls
items.what: SETTINGS overlay (G23xp): six options appear as empty gray rounded squares with no fill, check or switch track; the left-handed explanation and career stats line are even smaller and lower-contrast.
items.why: Accessibility features (reduced motion, large controls, left-handed, high contrast) that already exist are undiscoverable, so players who need them never enable them.
items.how: Replace squares with standard 44 pt switches or clearly checked boxes, raise label contrast, and give the career stats its own larger row.
